# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP support. It bumps through Skia milestones 132-148, adds variable font and color-font-palette support, animated WebP encoding, and native dependency refreshes across freetype, harfbuzz, libpng, zlib, and expat. This is a breaking release — check the changes below before upgrading, especially if you use Vulkan or rely on default-typeface null checks.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default** — Upstream removed the lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) explicitly, and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default, not null** — SkiaSharp seeds a usable default font so text still works, but paint.Typeface == null no longer detects "no typeface set". Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead, or drop the check. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") returns Default instead of null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null** — Default resolution moved to the font manager. Behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux; Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete** — The overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it's now [Obsolete] and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (unrecoverable process termination, not an exception) if the minimum isn't met. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 in both your VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0). Hardware that is genuinely Vulkan-1.0-only can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality** — The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (adding a new Components field), and the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or the equality operators. Update code that compared instances with == or Equals. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors** — Legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and other pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors instead of warnings, and obsolete enum members were trimmed from the reference assembly. Migrate to the SKFont-based APIs called out in the obsolete messages. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205), [#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestones 132 to 148** — Steps the bundled Skia engine forward across five milestones to m148, merging multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, adds color font palette support, and improves variable font robustness overall. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and a zero-copy SKStream.GetData() for turning a stream directly into an SKData. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **GPU sampling and color API additions** — Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and fills in missing API wrappers while fixing naming-convention violations. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access stride and offset fixes** — Fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride, and fixes the GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset calculation, which was using Height instead of Width. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Fixes a crash when an SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it built, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found by .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **MAUI TabBar rendering fix** — Fixes SKGLView not rendering again after switching MAUI TabBar tabs on Android. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Apple TFM and native-asset platform support** — Fixes Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), adds Tizen x64/arm64 and Linux Bionic native asset support, and drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten/WASM. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates freetype, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib, and expat to their latest maintained versions across this line. ([#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.0 alongside the variable font and color-font-palette work, adding the new HBColor struct for hb_color_t.
